title: Open-vocabulary Video Question Answering: A New Benchmark for Evaluating the Generalizability of Video Question Answering Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended VideoQA models on a new benchmark (OVQA) that categorizes test answers into base (frequent), common, rare, and unseen categories, and measuring the Base and Non-base performance Gap (BNG) to quantify the model's reliance on frequent training set answers.

Qualitatively analyzing model predictions on specific question prefixes (e.g., questions starting with 'Is') to determine if the model defaults to statistically probable answers ('yes' or 'no') based on text priors rather than visual evidence.
